facts.fact: Consolidated revenues were $119.8 billion, up 24% year over year (GAAP, as reported). Basis context the brief need not state: growth was 23% in constant currency, a non-GAAP measure.
facts.quote: Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 24%, or 23% in constant currency, to $119.8 billion, reflecting strong performance across the business and our 12th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.
facts.location: first bullet under the headline; revenues row of the financial highlights table and the statement of income
common_errors: reporting the non-GAAP constant currency growth of 23% as the headline growth rate
using year-to-date revenues of $229,692 million as the quarter
using the sequential growth of 9% (versus $109,896 million in Q1 2026) as the year-over-year rate
using Google Services revenues ($94.5 billion) as total revenues

facts.fact: GAAP diluted EPS was $9.11, up 294% year over year. Basis context the brief need not state: the prior-year figure was $2.31, and the release reports no adjusted EPS.
facts.quote: Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% and EPS increased 294% to $9.11.
facts.location: sixth bullet under the headline; diluted net income per common share row of the financial highlights table and the statement of income
common_errors: using the 298% net income growth as the EPS growth rate
reporting basic EPS of $9.23 as diluted
using year-to-date diluted EPS of $14.24
labeling $9.11 as adjusted or non-GAAP
presenting $9.11 as operating performance without noting that $6.26 of it came from the equity securities gain

facts.fact: Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion, a meaningful acceleration and the release's headline growth story.
facts.quote: Google Cloud saw a meaningful acceleration in growth as revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion, led by an increase in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure, as well as core GCP services.
facts.location: third bullet under the headline; Google Cloud row of the supplemental revenues table and segment results table; CEO quote
common_errors: confusing Cloud revenues with Cloud operating income of $8,814 million
attributing the 82% to Google Cloud Platform alone rather than the Google Cloud segment
confusing Cloud's 82% with total revenue growth of 24%

facts.fact: Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion.
facts.quote: Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion, led by 17% growth in Google Search & other, 15% in Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices, and 13% in YouTube ads.
facts.location: second bullet under the headline; Google Services total row of the supplemental revenues table
common_errors: using Google advertising revenues of $81,629 million as Google Services
using Google Search & other growth of 17% as the segment growth rate
confusing Google Services revenues with Google Services operating income of $39,544 million

facts.fact: Operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34% (GAAP).
facts.quote: Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.
facts.location: fourth bullet under the headline; operating margin row of the financial highlights table
common_errors: stating the margin rose 2% rather than 2 percentage points
using the 30% operating income growth as the margin change
confusing operating margin with net margin, which is inflated by the $98.0 billion other income gain

facts.fact: Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily net unrealized gains on equity securities; the net effect of the equity securities gain increased diluted EPS by $6.26.
facts.quote: Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily the result of net unrealized gains on our equity securities.
facts.location: fifth bullet under the headline; other income (expense), net row of the financial highlights table and the other income table; the $6.26 EPS effect is in footnote (1) to the other income (expense), net table ('increased the provision for income tax, net income, and diluted net income per common share by $21.9 billion, $77.1 billion, and $6.26, respectively')
equivalent_phrasings: added $77.1 billion to net income and $6.26 to diluted EPS
the $99.0 billion gain on equity securities added $6.26 to diluted EPS (only when labeled as the equity securities gain, not as total other income)
common_errors: describing the gain as realized or as cash
treating the gain as part of operating income
confusing the $98.0 billion total other income with the $99.0 billion gain on equity securities line
confusing the $77.1 billion net income effect with the $99.0 billion pre-tax gain
treating the $6.26 as a charge rather than a benefit
presenting a computed ex-gain EPS (such as $2.85) as a company-reported adjusted figure

facts.fact: Google Cloud operating income was $8,814 million, versus $2,826 million a year earlier.
facts.location: Google Cloud row under operating income (loss) in the segment operating results table (Supplemental Information) and in the Segment Results table
common_errors: confusing Cloud operating income with Cloud revenues of $24,768 million
using Google Services operating income of $39,544 million or total income from operations of $40,770 million
reversing the periods (the table lists 2025 first: 2,826 is Q2 2025 and 8,814 is Q2 2026)
stating a Cloud operating income growth rate or Cloud operating margin as a reported figure (the release prints neither)
labeling Cloud operating income as non-GAAP or adjusted

facts.quote: In June 2026, we issued a combination of Class A stock and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion, to be used for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures to scale AI infrastructure and global compute.
facts.location: Equity Capital Raise paragraph under Additional Information
equivalent_phrasings: $30,499 million of common stock and $19,063 million of mandatory convertible preferred stock
common_errors: adding the $40.0 billion ATM Program, under which no shares had been sold as of June 30, 2026
adding the $20.3 billion of senior unsecured notes, which is debt
describing the raise as common stock only
describing the raise as a buyback

facts.fact: Free cash flow (non-GAAP) was negative at (5,855) million in Q2 2026, after purchases of property and equipment (a GAAP cash flow statement line) of (44,924) million.
facts.location: reconciliation from GAAP net cash provided by operating activities to non-GAAP free cash flow, Q2 2026 column; (44,924) is also the Q2 2026 purchases of property and equipment row of the GAAP statement of cash flows
equivalent_phrasings: negative free cash flow of $5,855 million
free cash flow of negative $5.86 billion
operating cash flow of $39,069 million less capex of $44,924 million
common_errors: labeling free cash flow as GAAP
using TTM free cash flow of $53,273 million as the quarter
using year-to-date capex of $80,598 million as the quarter
reporting operating cash flow of $39,069 million as free cash flow

facts.fact: Alphabet repurchased no stock in Q2 2026 (0, versus (13,238) million in Q2 2025), so capital return in the quarter was dividends only.
facts.location: repurchases of stock row, financing activities, statement of cash flows
equivalent_phrasings: no share repurchases in the quarter
no buybacks versus $13.2 billion a year earlier
common_errors: stating a buyback amount or authorization for Q2 2026 (none was made or announced)
treating the $40.0 billion ATM Program, which sells shares, as a repurchase program
confusing dividend payments of $2,689 million with repurchases
claiming the release announces a suspension of the buyback program (it only reports zero repurchases)

traps: GAAP vs constant currency: revenue grew 24% as reported and 23% in constant currency, which is non-GAAP; the headline growth is 24%.
EPS of $9.11 is GAAP and includes $6.26 from the $99.0 billion equity securities gain; the release gives no adjusted EPS, so any ex-gain EPS is analyst arithmetic, not a reported figure.

Three similar gain figures: other income (expense), net of $98.0 billion ($97,983 million), the gain on equity securities of $99.0 billion ($99,031 million), and the cash flow add-back of $(98,999) million; they are not interchangeable.

Net income available to common stockholders rose 298% while EPS rose 294%; net income is $112,193 million and net income available to common stockholders is $112,107 million after $86 million of preferred dividends.
Operating margin rose 2 percentage points (32% to 34%), not 2%; operating income rose 30%.
Quarter vs year to date: the statements carry year-to-date columns ($229,692 million revenue, $14.24 diluted EPS, $80,598 million capex).

Segment vs total: Google Services is $94.5 billion, Google advertising $81,629 million, Search & other $63,271 million, total revenues $119.8 billion; Cloud growth of 82% is a segment rate, not the company rate.
Free cash flow is non-GAAP and negative in Q2 2026 ((5,855) million) but positive on a TTM basis (53,273 million).
Financing: the $49.6 billion equity raise, the $20.3 billion senior notes, and the $40.0 billion ATM Program (no sales as of June 30, 2026) are three separate items.
No guidance or outlook is given; any forward revenue, margin or capex range is invented.
Units: tables are in millions except per share figures and percentages; $24,768 million is $24.8 billion.
Basic EPS is $9.23 and diluted EPS is $9.11.
